summary: Iteration 2 (Spoilancer follow-up) PASSED. Backend regression: 7/7 pytest tests green (root /api/, /api/auth/me valid/no-auth/bogus, /api/auth/session bogus id -> 401, /api/advisor/analyze without auth -> 401, /api/advisor/analyze with 'test-token-abc' returns valid Gemini JSON with all 5 keys summary/overall_health/limit_suggestions/spoilance_suggestion/tips in ~7s). Frontend (Expo web, 390x844): CHANGE 3 Indian lakh/crore grouping VERIFIED on every requested input — stipend-input '4000000'->'40,00,000', field-amount-input '125000'->'1,25,000' AND '7777'->'7,777' (also in Limits screen), spoilance-alloc-input '500000'->'5,00,000', gate-amount-input '12345'->'12,345', edit-savings-input '1234567'->'12,34,567', edit-spoilance-input '300000'->'3,00,000', move-amount-input '55000'->'55,000', item-cost-0 '1500'->'1,500'. Projected-savings math correct on the 9/9 summary step. CHANGE 2 (SMS): sms-auto-unsupported fallback card renders on web, sms-input + sms-parse-button detect '₹250' from 'Rs 250 debited', graceful message shown when no unlogged field exists (expected — same behaviour as iter1). CHANGE 1 (tab bar): bottom tabs Home/History/Profile present, tappable, switch tabs, and have a visible translucent BlurView+rgba(13,13,17,0.82) fill (content no longer bleeds). CHANGE 4 (notification reply): app boots with NotificationResponder mounted, no red screen / crash from category registration (only pre-existing RN-web warnings). BUTTON AUDIT: all requested testIDs render and are tappable — login (continue-offline-button + google-signin-button), onboarding (onboarding-back/continue, add-field-button, copy-previous-day, field editor + all 4 validations blocking save on empty title / bad amount / hour=25 / minute=77, spoilance-preset-0.25, onboarding-finish), gate (typed '12345'->'12,345' formatting + gate-submit-button), Home (profile-avatar, edit-balances-button, action-edit-limits/advisor/parse-sms/history, spoilance-logger-fab), Balances modal (edit-savings-input, edit-spoilance-input, move-amount-input, save-balances-button closes modal, move-to-savings-button, edit-balances-close), Limits (limits-back, day-chip-0..6, limits-add-button opens editor with comma-formatted field-amount-input, field-editor-close), Spoilance Logger (logger-close, count-plus/minus/continue, item-name-0, item-cost-0 formatted, add-item-row, running-total, save-spoilance-button), Advisor (advisor-back visible, advisor-analyze-button shows expected 'Sign in with Google to use the AI Advisor' toast in guest mode), History renders with all-time savings/spoilance cards, Profile (setting-language/reminders/limits/app/signout/wipe all present; language modal exposes 6 lang-* options + lang-close; App Settings shows settings-back + reminders-switch). NO React Native red screens, no crashes. Deprecated packages check: none of expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch imported. Only minor pre-existing RN-web console warnings ('shadow*' deprecated, 'props.pointerEvents' deprecated) — same as iter1, non-blocking.

ui_bugs.issue: Large savings values overflow / truncate (e.g. ₹30,000 rendered as '₹30,0...' when both hero numbers shown side-by-side on 390px wide viewport). Consider adjustsFontSizeToFit / numberOfLines={1} + minimumFontScale, or shrink font when value width > container.

issues: Savings hero currency string may truncate on narrow viewports — auto-shrink font recommended.

react_native_issues.issue: Tab items in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx lack testIDs — only reachable via a[href="/home"] etc. Add options={{ tabBarButtonTestID: 'tab-home' }} (or a custom tabBarButton) so QA / Detox / Playwright can target Home/History/Profile tabs deterministically. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx:41-70
Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Same as iter1 — cosmetic, RN-web only. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components (GlassCard / Toast)
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Same as iter1 — cosmetic, RN-web only.

action_items: Add tabBarButtonTestID (or a testID-forwarding custom tabBarButton) to each Tabs.Screen in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx so tests can target tab-home / tab-history / tab-profile without falling back to href selectors.

Make the Home hero card numeric values shrink-to-fit (adjustsFontSizeToFit on iOS + numberOfLines={1} + minimumFontScale, or use FitText-like helper) so large balances like ₹1,00,00,000 do not truncate as '₹30,0...'.
Cosmetic (carry-over from iter1): migrate remaining shadow* style props to boxShadow for RN-web parity and replace prop-based pointerEvents with style.pointerEvents to silence deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: Indian-grouping formatter is applied consistently across every numeric input requested (stipend / field-amount / spoilance-alloc / gate / edit-savings / edit-spoilance / move-amount / item-cost) — good DRY.
Advisor guest-mode block is enforced at UI layer with a clear toast — matches product intent; backend still enforces auth (verified via pytest).
BlurView + rgba(13,13,17,0.82) overlay in TabBarBackground correctly fixes the transparent bleed-through; tab bar remains visible on scroll.
parse-sms.tsx correctly surfaces sms-auto-unsupported fallback when isNativeSmsSupported() is false — matches Expo Go / web behaviour; manual paste path unaffected.
server.py continues to return 401 (not 403) for missing/invalid auth and excludes MongoDB _id via projection — good.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all requested flows + comma formatting verified; tab bar reached via href selectors due to missing testIDs)

rca_of_issue: No functional issues. All 4 change-requests (tab-bar fill, SMS fallback, comma-on-type, notification responder mount) and the full button audit pass end-to-end. The only new observations are minor: (a) tab items missing testIDs, (b) Home hero card can truncate very large savings values, and (c) two pre-existing RN-web console deprecation warnings from iter1 remain non-blocking.
